text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, my head's not in the game 
at all. I'm just completely out of it."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
To the point where I can hardly remember 
how I used to run before...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me to keep running 
like this?
choice_data_list: Still, you never said you wouldn't run.
But you never said you wouldn't run

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: Then I have no choice but to keep running.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ... Even for someone as spineless as me?
choice_data_list:
If you stay half-hearted, you'll only 
lose.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hah... That's pretty harsh of you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No way. That would be... way too uncool.
